title: 从“听故事”到“存历史”：汕大在新加坡为潮籍侨领留下口述档案
subtitle: 汕头大学启动第五个国别口述史工程，记录20位新加坡潮籍杰出侨领的奋斗与奉献
summary: 近日，汕头大学在新加坡启动第五个国别口述史工程，对20位潮籍杰出侨领深度访谈，记录其艰苦创业与在地奉献。团队还走访醉花林俱乐部、同济医院、潮州八邑会馆等地标，把田野与侨社现实相联结。口述史是对抗记忆流失的“活档案”，也揭示海外华人的在地化，是文化保持与社会融入之间的反复协商。

en.title: From “Hearing Stories” to “Keeping History”
en.subtitle: Shantou University launches its fifth country oral-history project, recording twenty prominent Teochew leaders in Singapore
en.summary: Shantou University's Institute of Area Studies and Overseas Chinese has launched its fifth country oral-history project in Singapore, conducting in-depth interviews with twenty prominent Teochew leaders on their migration, entrepreneurship and local contribution. The team also visited landmarks such as Chui Huay Lim Club, Thung Wai Hospital and the Teochew Poit Ip Huay Kuan, linking fieldwork to diaspora reality. Oral history is a 'living archive' against memory loss, and reveals that overseas-Chinese localisation is a repeated negotiation between cultural retention and social embedding.
en.imageAlt: Bustling street scene in Singapore's Chinatown

title: “马来人在朝，华人在野”：民行党去留背后的华人政治困局
subtitle: 民主行动党拟8月16日表决退出团结政府，折射马来西亚族裔化政治中华人的结构性位置
summary: 8月16日，马来西亚民主行动党4000余名代表将表决是否退出团结政府。若成真，更可能加速“马来人在朝、华人在野”格局。陆兆福失守真纳州席、2022年非马来多数席仅33席，折射跨族群政党的天花板；华社不满教育承诺，马来社会又视其为威胁。海外华人的政治前途，往往嵌于居住国的族群权力结构之中。
imageAlt: 吉隆坡城市天际线

references.title: 民行党若退出团结政府牵连广 恐现“马来人在朝华人在野”格局

en.title: “Malays in Government, Chinese in Opposition”
en.subtitle: The DAP's looming exit vote reflects the structural place of ethnic Chinese within Malaysia's ethnicised politics
en.summary: On 16 August, more than 4,000 DAP delegates will vote on quitting the Unity Government. If they do, it not only threatens Pakatan Harapan's survival but may accelerate a 'Malays in government, Chinese in opposition' order amid converging Malay votes. Loke's loss in Taman Jauhar and only 33 Peninsular seats with non-Malay majorities in 2022 expose the ceiling facing cross-ethnic parties; Chinese voters fault broken education pledges while Malay society sees the party as a threat. The political fortune of a diaspora often hinges on the ethnic power structure it inhabits.
en.imageAlt: Kuala Lumpur city skyline

title: 稀土“去中国化”的一小步：马澳合作背后的供应链算计
subtitle: 马来西亚与澳大利亚加强稀土合作、探讨在马生产钕磁铁，是全球关键矿产“去风险”叙事下的一枚落子
summary: 8月11日，马来西亚环境部长与澳洲驻马最高专员会晤，同意加强稀土及关键矿产合作，探讨在马发展钕磁铁制造能力。莱纳斯自2012年落户关丹格宾，去年产出首批重稀土，是全球唯一中国以外可同时供应轻、重稀土的厂商。马国储量约1610万公吨却缺技术、禁原料出口。此举是供应链多元化尝试，短期难撼中国主导地位。
imageAlt: 露天采矿场的大型挖掘机械

references.title: 马澳加强稀土领域合作 探讨在马生产钕磁铁

en.title: A Small Step in Rare-Earth “De-Risking”
en.subtitle: Malaysia–Australia rare-earth cooperation and neodymium-magnet plans are a move within the global critical-minerals narrative
en.summary: On 11 August, Malaysia's Nik Nazmi met Australia's high commissioner, agreeing to deepen rare-earth and critical-minerals cooperation and explore neodymium-magnet manufacturing. Lynas, in Gebeng since 2012, produced its first heavy-rare-earth batch last year and is the only producer outside China supplying both light and heavy rare earths; it pledged RM500 million (about S$154 million) last October to expand. Malaysia holds some 16.1 million tonnes of reserves but lacks technology and bans raw exports. The move diversifies supply chains yet is unlikely to shift China's dominance soon.
en.imageAlt: Large excavators at an open-pit mine

title: 从新中式餐厅到新一代侨团：一位法国新侨的“本色与创新”
subtitle: 徐𬱖在里昂从餐饮创业到组建青年侨团，为欧洲新侨群体提供了一条创新与扎根并行的样本
summary: 2009年赴法求学的徐𬱖，从餐厅兼职到创办新式中餐厅，再到2026年3月成立法国奥罗阿中法青年协会。她以“新中式”餐饮平衡本色与创新，又顺着青年侨胞缺少交流平台的痛点组建新侨团。这条从餐桌到组织的路径，为理解欧洲新侨群体提供了一对微观样本：创新不必以丢掉本色为代价。

en.title: From a New-Chinese Restaurant to a New Generation of Diaspora Associations
en.subtitle: Xu Di's path from F&B entrepreneurship to a youth association in Lyon offers a micro-specimen of Europe's new Chinese migrants
en.summary: Xu Di came to France in 2009 and moved from restaurant shifts to a fusion eatery, then in March 2026 founded the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes China-France Youth Association. Balancing 'authenticity and innovation' in dining, she later built a youth association to fill young compatriots' need for connection. The table-to-organisation path is a telling micro-specimen of Europe's new migrant generation.
en.imageAlt: Basilica of Notre-Dame de Fourvière and Lyon cityscape, France

title: 举债近700亿新元救经济：小马科斯的政治赌注与财政红线
subtitle: 二季度增速跌至2.3%的菲律宾，以明年举债3.3万亿比索的计划试图重启增长，但债务底色不容乐观
summary: 受建筑业低迷与内需疲软拖累，菲律宾二季度GDP仅增2.3%，创2021年以来最低。马尼拉开出药方：明年举债3.3万亿比索（约690亿新元，约合3720亿元人民币），较今年高五分之一。但截至6月未偿债务已达19.07万亿比索、约占GDP的66%，新增借款近半用于还债。刺激与红线之间，是小马科斯的两难。
imageAlt: 菲律宾马尼拉现代化城市滨水景观

en.title: Borrowing S$69 Billion to Rescue the Economy
en.subtitle: With Q2 growth at 2.3%, Manila bets on 3.3 trillion pesos of new debt to restart growth — yet the debt backdrop is sobering
en.summary: Weighed by a sluggish construction sector and weak demand, the Philippine economy grew just 2.3% in Q2, its slowest since 2021. Manila's remedy: borrow 3.3 trillion pesos (about S$69 billion, ~US$53 billion) next year, a fifth above this year. But outstanding debt already stood at 19.07 trillion pesos, some 66% of GDP, and nearly half the new borrowing goes to repayment. Between stimulus and red lines lies Marcos's dilemma.
en.imageAlt: Modern waterfront cityscape of Manila, Philippines

title: 澳越深化军事合作：供应链韧性背后的南海棋局
subtitle: 苏林以双重身份首访澳大利亚，两国在防务、供应链与南海议题上同步靠拢，折射印太板块重组
summary: 8月11日，越南国家主席苏林首次以总书记兼国家主席双重身份访澳，与澳总理阿尔巴尼斯同意深化军事合作、共建关键矿产与半导体供应链韧性，并就南海表达关切。这份联合声明释放三重信号：防务升级、供应链绑定、在中美博弈夹缝中各自的战略自主。对东南亚观察者，澳越走近是印太重组的一枚注脚。

en.title: Australia and Vietnam Deepen Defence Ties
en.subtitle: To Lam's first visit to Australia in his dual role signals closer defence, supply-chain and South China Sea alignment amid Indo-Pacific realignment
en.summary: On 11 August, Vietnamese President To Lam visited Australia for the first time as both Party General Secretary and State President, agreeing with PM Albanese to deepen military cooperation and build resilient supply chains in critical minerals and semiconductors, while voicing concern over the South China Sea. The joint statement sends three signals — upgraded defence, bound supply chains, and strategic autonomy amid US-China rivalry. For Southeast Asia watchers, the rapprochement is a footnote to Indo-Pacific reordering.
en.imageAlt: Cargo ship on the Saigon River with Ho Chi Minh City skyline, Vietnam

title: 从“引资引智”到“服务到人”：新时代侨务工作的范式转移，与东南亚的试金石
subtitle: 全国侨务工作会议落幕后，专家以“向实、向新、向未来”勾勒侨务新方向；但从“引资引智”到“服务到人”的范式转移，在东南亚族裔政治面前将遭遇真正的试金石。
summary: 中国侨网以"向实、向新、向未来"勾勒侨务从"引资引智"向"服务到人"的转向。本文认为这更成熟，却也意味着争夺辖区外侨胞的忠诚；以东南亚为试金石，"服务侨胞"在雅加达、马尼拉反而印证"第五纵队"猜疑，软实力存在硬天花板。
imageAlt: 一名身着舞狮服的表演者在人群前起舞，红黄相间的狮头映出海外华人社区借文化维系身份认同的生动场景。

en.title: From “wooing capital” to “serving people”: the paradigm shift in China's diaspora governance — and Southeast Asia as the stress test
en.subtitle: A week after Beijing's qiaowu work conference, experts sketched a “pragmatic, new, forward-looking” agenda. But the shift from tapping capital to serving people meets its real stress test in Southeast Asia's ethnic politics.
en.summary: China Qiao Wang's expert roundtable “向实、向新、向未来” outlines a turn in new-era qiaowu work from “bringing in capital and talent” to “serving people.” This analysis argues the shift is more mature yet means the state competing for the loyalty of people outside its jurisdiction; tested in Southeast Asia, “serving the diaspora” can confirm, not dispel, host-nation suspicions of a “fifth column,” leaving soft power a hard ceiling. Cultural “soft connectivity” is the more restrained frontier, though digitisation may read abroad as reach.
en.imageAlt: A performer in a lion-dance costume moves before a crowd, the red-and-gold lion head capturing how overseas Chinese communities sustain identity through culture.

references.title: 向实、向新、向未来 专家谈新时代侨务工作

title: 普拉博沃提名德斯特莉执掌印尼央行：稳住印尼盾，也稳住政治账本
subtitle: 代行长德斯特莉成为唯一提名人选，市场以印尼盾升值0.7%投下信任票；但央行独立性这道老问题，仍悬在增长诉求与货币纪律之间。
summary: 8月10日，普拉博沃提名代行长德斯特莉为唯一央行行长人选，市场以印尼盾升值0.7%投下信任票。但今年以来股市流失约三成、印尼盾数度创新低，信任缺口犹在。德斯特莉务实却可能更迎合政府，央行独立性疑虑难消；提名暂稳货币与叙事，真正的考验在确认之后。
imageAlt: 雅加达夜幕下的城市天际线，摩天楼群灯火通明，映照出这个东南亚最大经济体在货币信心与增长诉求之间的张力。

en.title: Prabowo names Destry Damayanti to lead Bank Indonesia: steadying the rupiah, and the political ledger
en.subtitle: Acting governor Destry Damayanti as the sole nominee; markets answered with a 0.7% rupiah gain — yet the old question of central-bank independence still hangs between growth demands and monetary discipline.
en.summary: On 10 August Prabowo named acting governor Destry Damayanti as the sole Bank Indonesia nominee; the rupiah rose 0.7% in a vote for continuity. Yet equities have shed roughly 30% this year and the rupiah hit record lows, leaving a trust gap. Destry is pragmatic but likely more accommodating to government, and Prabowo's growth agenda keeps independence concerns alive. The nomination steadied currency and narrative for now; the real test comes after confirmation.
en.imageAlt: Jakarta's skyline at dusk, skyscrapers alight, mirroring the tension of Southeast Asia's largest economy between monetary confidence and growth demands.

subtitle: 缅甸同意派船接收5000名滞留马国的罗兴亚人，马国将先筛查后遣返首批逾4000人；在东盟五点共识始终落空的背景下，这更像是一个承受力见顶的信号。
summary: 8月10日，马外长宣布缅甸同意派船接收5000名滞留罗兴亚人，马国将先筛查逾4000名缅甸公民后再启动首批遣返。遣返虽缓解行政压力，却绕不开缅甸局势这一安全前提，而东盟五点共识迄未落实，缺乏实质背书。十余年的“接收—滞留—遣返”循环，暴露的是东盟区域治理缺乏强制干预与难民分担机制的结构性缺口。

en.title: Malaysia to repatriate 4,000+ Rohingya: a humanitarian quandary or a gap in regional governance?
en.subtitle: Myanmar agreed to send ships for 5,000 Rohingya stranded in Malaysia; Kuala Lumpur will screen then return the first 4,000-plus — a signal of strained capacity as ASEAN's Five-Point Consensus remains unfulfilled.
en.summary: On 10 August Malaysia said Myanmar would send ships for 5,000 stranded Rohingya; Kuala Lumpur will screen 4,000-plus detainees before the first repatriation. Repatriation eases administrative pressure yet cannot bypass Myanmar's unresolved security situation, and with the ASEAN Five-Point Consensus unimplemented it lacks a real safety backstop. A decade-plus cycle of receiving, detaining and returning exposes ASEAN's structural gap: no coercive leverage, no shared refugee-burden mechanism.
en.imageAlt: Kuala Lumpur's skyline anchored by the Petronas Twin Towers, modern towers stretching under blue sky — a symbol of the capacity and dilemma of a country hosting some 200,000 Rohingya.

summary: 8月7日，潮汕方言片《给阿嬷的情书》在印尼公映，华社侨团公益包场，华侨华人在乡音中重温“下南洋”往事。影片以世界记忆遗产“侨批”为线索，串联潮汕与南洋两代人情感。本文认为，侨团包场是社区记忆的集体再生产；华人“落地生根”的今天，“下南洋”记忆仍是连接世代与中外侨社的柔软桥梁。

en.title: When "silver letters" echo in Jakarta: why a Teochew-dialect film moves Indonesia's Chinese
en.subtitle: Dear You (《给阿嬷的情书》) premiered in Indonesia on 7 August with charitable group screenings by Chinese associations; how does a Teochew film about qiaopi and 'going to Nanyang' awaken a shared memory across the Nanyang Chinese world?
en.summary: On 7 August the Teochew-dialect film Dear You premiered in Indonesia, with Chinese associations staging charitable screenings that let ethnic Chinese revisit the 'going to Nanyang' past in familiar dialect. Built around the Memory-of-the-World heritage qiaopi, the film links two generations across Teochew and Nanyang. Its 'qiaopi narrative' crosses dialect and border to awaken a shared memory — and the associations' bookings are, in essence, a collective reproduction of community memory.
en.imageAlt: A street scene in Jakarta's Chinatown, with people moving among old shophouses and stalls — the everyday texture of a Nanyang Chinese community.

summary: 2026年8月8日，马来西亚教育部首次以主办方身份举办全国小学二十四节令鼓邀请赛，并以创始人陈徽崇之名命名“徽崇杯”。16队、417名小鼓手中非华族逾一成。真正的新闻是谁来办：这项1988年由华人在新山创造的鼓艺，用38年从社团自筹走进国家教育体制。

en.title: Thirty-Eight Years to Enter the System: Malaysia's 24 Festive Drums Joins the National Education Fold
en.subtitle: From nine drums at a Johor Bahru temple to a ministry-run “Hooi Chong Cup” — how a Chinese-Malaysian invention completed both its localisation and its nationalisation
en.summary: On 8 August 2026 Malaysia's Education Ministry convened its first national primary-school 24 Festive Drums invitational, the "Hooi Chong Cup" named after co-founder Tan Hooi Chong. Sixteen teams, 417 young drummers, over 10 per cent of them non-Chinese. The news is who convened it: a drum art created by Chinese Malaysians in Johor Bahru in 1988 took 38 years to move from community funding into the state education system.

en.title: When the Third-Country Door Closes: Malaysia Starts “Screening for Return” on 4,000 Myanmar Nationals
en.subtitle: From vanishing resettlement to organised repatriation — how a non-signatory state is filling a legal vacuum with administrative procedure
en.summary: On 9 August Malaysia's home minister said third-country resettlement had become 'very slim' and launched status screening for returns, starting with 4,000-plus Myanmar nationals in detention. The arithmetic is brutal: over 215,000 registered refugees but only 2,585 resettled or repatriated in 2025 — about 1.2 per cent a year. Screening from detention is efficient yet most suspect by protection standards, and the 'Myanmar refugees' label dissolves statelessness into easier cases — the echo of a receding global protection system.

summary: 2026年7月29日，菲国防部长援引美智库报告，将暨南大学面向菲华校的教师培训定性为安全议题，原定8月田野调查取消。讽刺在于：菲148所华校、7万余学生全靠华社自筹，而“每天最多两小时”的中文课时上限，恰是马尼拉1973年“菲化”法令自定的。文章以公开、对象、强制、社群同意四条标准，质疑安全化叙事。
imageAlt: 马尼拉街头行人往来的日常景象，比农多一带是世界上最早的海外华人聚居区，四百余年来华人社群在此办学、行医、经商。

en.title: Two Hours a Day: How a Philippine Classroom Timetable Became a Security File
en.subtitle: The Philippine defense secretary, citing an American think-tank report, has filed Chinese-language teacher training under national security. A dispute about Mandarin lessons is reopening a question the Philippines sealed fifty years ago.
en.summary: On 29 July 2026, Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr., citing a US think-tank SeaLight report, branded Jinan University's teacher training for Philippine Chinese schools as 'huge evidence' of schools being misused, prompting the cancellation of a three-week August fieldwork. The irony this essay notes: the Philippines' 148 Chinese schools and 70,000 students are community-funded, yet the two-hour daily Mandarin cap was set by Manila's own 1973 Filipinization decree. Using four symmetry criteria — disclosure, capacity, coercion, consent — the piece questions the methodological basis of the securitization narrative.
en.imageAlt: Pedestrians going about their day on a Manila street. Binondo, the surrounding district, is recognised as the world's oldest Chinatown, where the Chinese community has built schools, hospitals and businesses for over four centuries.

title: 从"落叶归根"到"落地生根"：印尼华裔总会换届背后的身份之变
subtitle: 黄印华履新印尼华裔总会（INTI）2026—2030年度总主席，一句"落叶归根"到"落地生根"，道出全球最大华侨华人聚居国数十年的身份之变。
summary: 8月7日，印尼华裔总会（INTI）新一届理监事会就职，黄印华任2026—2030总主席。他“从落叶归根到落地生根”之说，折射出印尼——全球华侨华人最多国家——身份认同数十年的静默变迁。本文梳理华人社团从维权到融入的演变，并指出中国崛起赋予新一代更有底气的双重身份；青年接棒则是老牌侨社共同的代际挑战。
imageAlt: 一座挂满红色灯笼与彩带的东南亚中式寺庙，红金装饰在绿意中格外醒目，象征华人文化在当地的生根与传承。

en.title: From "returning to the roots" to "taking root locally": the quiet shift in Indonesia's ethnic-Chinese identity
en.subtitle: Huang Yinhua assumes the 2026–2030 chairmanship of Indonesia's Chinese Association (INTI); his 'falling leaves return to roots' to 'take root locally' captures a decades-long identity shift in the world's largest overseas-Chinese population.
en.summary: On 7 August 2026 the new board of Indonesia's Chinese Association (INTI) was inaugurated in Jakarta, with Huang Yinhua assuming the 2026–2030 chairmanship. His 'from falling leaves return to roots, to taking root where we stand' captures a decades-long shift in ethnic-Chinese identity in the world's largest overseas-Chinese population. This piece maps INTI's move from rights-defense to social integration and how China's rise gives a new generation the confidence to hold a dual identity; youth succession remains the shared generational challenge.
en.imageAlt: A Southeast Asian Chinese temple hung with red lanterns and festive bunting, its red-and-gold ornamentation vivid against the greenery — a symbol of Chinese culture taking root and enduring locally.

title: 从妈祖庙到气象预警：当中国方案遇上东南亚的最后一公里
subtitle: 以妈祖命名的中国气象预警方案已落地7国，却尚未进入东南亚——文化最深厚的地区为何成为技术盲区？
summary: 2026年7月，中方宣布推动气象预警方案妈祖（MAZU）在30国落地；截至8月已在7国部署、40余国云端使用，东南亚十国却无一正式接入。悖论在于：东南亚正是妈祖信俗最深厚地区，数千座宫庙构成现成社区网络。预警瓶颈不在卫星而在“最后一公里”；中泰联合实验室标志破局，华侨宫庙网络可作官方预警的有益补充。
imageAlt: 一名信众在传统中式寺庙的香炉前上香祈祷，香烟袅袅升起，象征妈祖信仰跨越千年的守护精神。

en.title: From Mazu Temples to Early Warning Systems: When China's MAZU Meets Southeast Asia's Last Mile
en.subtitle: China's Mazu-named early warning system is live in seven countries — yet absent from Southeast Asia, where Mazu belief runs deepest. Why?
en.summary: At WAIC 2026 China announced it would deploy its MAZU early-warning system in 30 countries; as of August it runs in seven nations with cloud access in 40-plus, yet no Southeast Asian state has formally onboarded. The paradox: Southeast Asia is where Mazu faith runs deepest, its thousands of temples a ready community network. The bottleneck is the last mile, not satellites; the China–Thailand lab marks the regional entry point, and diaspora temples could supplement official warnings within WMO's Single Authoritative Voice principle.
en.imageAlt: A worshipper prays before an incense burner at a traditional Chinese temple, smoke rising gently — symbolizing Mazu's thousand-year legacy of protection.

title: 保护海外华侨的正当权益：一项国家义务，也是战略资产
subtitle: 从宪法义务到专门立法，再到西方的双重标准——解读中国侨务工作的法律与战略逻辑
summary: 2026年8月初全国侨务工作会议重申，保护海外华侨正当权益是侨务工作“重中之重”。本文从法律与战略双重视角解读：宪法与《领事保护条例》构成保护基石，也门、苏丹等地撤离行动是最实在后盾；西方将中国侨务污名化为“干涉内政”，实属双重标准。在东南亚，依法护侨既是国家义务，也是民心相通的战略资产。
imageAlt: 夜色中的唐人街，红灯笼沿街悬挂，象征海外华侨华人的社区与乡愁。

en.title: At the Heart of China's Diaspora Work: The Legal and Strategic Logic of Protecting Overseas Chinese
en.subtitle: From constitutional duty to dedicated legislation, and the Western double standard — reading the legal and strategic logic of China's diaspora work
en.summary: A conference in early August 2026 reaffirmed that protecting overseas Chinese is the 'top priority' of diaspora work. This piece reads it from legal and strategic angles: the Constitution and the 2023 Consular Protection and Assistance Regulations form the bedrock, while evacuations from Yemen, Sudan, and Lebanon are the concrete backstop. Western framing of China's diaspora work as 'interference' is a double-standard reprocessing of the 'China threat' thesis — and, in Southeast Asia, lawful protection is both duty and a strategic asset for people-to-people ties.
en.imageAlt: A Chinatown at night, red lanterns lining the street — symbolizing the community and nostalgia of overseas Chinese.

country: 印度尼西亚 / 马来西亚
summary: 2026年8月初，印尼东爪哇国家公园燃起大火、过火逾120公顷；加里曼丹林火烟霾跨境飘入马来西亚，砂拉越空污达“不健康”水平。厄尔尼诺延长旱季下，烟霾再度暴露东盟跨境治理的“软约束”：火在一国烧、代价多国担。真正降本之策，是更早预警、更透明火点共享与国内执行。
imageAlt: 烟笼下的森林，树木轮廓在烟尘中若隐若现，呼应跨境烟霾的环境主题。

en.title: Java's Park Fire and the Cross-Border Haze: Climate, Governance, and ASEAN's Recurring Headache
en.subtitle: From East Java's park fire to Kalimantan's transboundary haze — Southeast Asia's 'tragedy of the commons' in regional governance
en.summary: In early August 2026, a fire broke out in East Java's Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park, burning over 120 hectares; smoke from Kalimantan drifted into Malaysia, pushing Sarawak's air to 'unhealthy' levels (Sibu peaked at 172). Under an El Niño-lengthened dry season, the haze again exposes ASEAN's 'soft-law' bind on transboundary pollution: the fire burns in one country, the cost is shared by many. What lowers the cost is earlier warning, transparent hotspot sharing, and domestic enforcement.
en.imageAlt: A forest shrouded in smoke, tree silhouettes fading into the haze — echoing the transboundary-haze theme.

subtitle: 巧思中心预测国阵国盟联手或夺西马122席——解析“蓝潮”的票仓、关键与真实上限
summary: 2026年8月8日，巧思中心预测：若国阵与国盟把森州合作扩及全西马、集中马来选票掀起“蓝潮”，有望在下届大选拿下西马166席中的122席。本文解析其票仓基础与基层互投关键，以及伊党强州、东马“造王者”构成的真实天花板——马来板块整合正重绘政党地图，但上限不只在选票数学。

en.title: A 'Blue Wave' in Malaysia? UMNO–PAS Malay-Vote Consolidation and Its Ceiling
en.subtitle: Ilham Centre projects a BN–PN alliance could take 122 Peninsular seats — reading the blue wave's base, pivot, and real ceiling
en.summary: On 8 August 2026, Ilham Centre projected that if BN and PN extended their Negeri Sembilan cooperation across Peninsular Malaysia and consolidated Malay votes into a 'blue wave,' they could take 122 of the 166 Peninsular seats — 10 above the government threshold. This piece reads the electoral base of the blue wave, the pivot of grassroots mutual voting, and the real ceiling set by PAS strongholds and East Malaysia's 'kingmaker' logic — the Malay bloc's consolidation is redrawing Malaysia's party map, but its limit lies beyond mere arithmetic.
en.imageAlt: Kuala Lumpur's skyline with the Petronas Twin Towers — a symbol of Malaysia's political and economic centre.

title: 三重夹击下菲律宾经济二季度失速：“幽灵工程”的反腐阵痛
subtitle: 反腐调查冻住基建、中东变局推高物价、增长模式软肋——同一季度三块短板同时掐住，菲律宾二季度GDP仅增2.3%
summary: 菲律宾二季度GDP同比仅增2.3%，创2009年以来（除疫情外）最慢。反腐调查冻结“幽灵工程”，建筑业萎缩14.8%、投资连降四季；中东紧张推高能源与物价，家庭消费放缓；消费、侨汇、基建三轮驱动同时承压。三季度或现温和复苏，但若反腐久拖、地缘紧绷，阵痛可能慢性化。
imageAlt: 马尼拉城市天际线，高楼与河流交织，象征菲律宾经济的城市脉动与不确定性。

en.title: The "Ghost Projects" Backlash: Philippines GDP Stalls in Q2 Under a Triple Whammy
en.subtitle: An anti-graft probe froze infrastructure, the Middle East shock lifted prices, and the growth model's soft underbelly showed — three short boards pinched at once, and Q2 GDP grew just 2.3%
en.summary: Philippine Q2 GDP grew just 2.3% year-on-year, the weakest since 2009 excluding pandemic years. An anti-graft probe froze 'ghost' infrastructure projects, construction fell 14.8%, and investment declined for a fourth straight quarter; Middle East tensions lifted energy and living costs, slowing household consumption. A mild Q3 recovery is possible, but if the cleanup drags and regional tension persists, the ache could become chronic.
en.imageAlt: Manila skyline where high-rises meet the river — urban pulse and uncertainty of the Philippine economy.

subtitle: 每天为学童与孕妇供一餐热食的社福标杆，却因每周浪费上亿份餐食、造成万亿印尼盾损失而遭反噬
summary: 普拉博沃的免费营养餐计划每周被浪费6200万至1.2亿份，损失约1.27万亿印尼盾。问题不在需求端，而在采购、烹饪到配送的链条损耗，以及“指定厨房”产能与冷链的行政短板。环保补丁治标不治本；当“免费”撞上“浪费”，损耗的不只是粮食，更是政策信用。

en.title: Prabowo's Free-Meals Ambition Meets a Mountain of Leftovers
en.subtitle: A flagship that feeds schoolchildren and pregnant women daily is now rebounding over reports it bins over a hundred million meals a week
en.summary: Prabowo's free nutritious-meals program wastes an estimated 62–120 million servings weekly, costing roughly 1.27 trillion rupiah. The leak is not on the demand side but in procurement, cooking, and distribution, as appointed kitchens struggle with capacity and cold-chain logistics. Environmental fixes treat symptoms, not causes; when 'free' meets waste, what erodes is not only food but policy credibility.

summary: 马来西亚华裔青年萧国庆“说好中文很酷”的口号，折射东南亚华人社区的身份转向：中文正从“祖辈义务”被重新定义为文化资本——进入中国市场的通行证、内容创作与跨国流动的工具。经济引力、留学与旅行热潮、社交媒体三股力量推动，但“酷”的重构也把他们推回地缘政治的放大镜下。

en.title: "Speaking Chinese Is Cool": How Southeast Asia's Ethnic Chinese Youth Are Rebranding a Heritage Language
en.subtitle: From a Malaysian student's "speaking Chinese is cool" to a generational reframing of a heritage tongue as cultural capital
en.summary: A young Malaysian's line — 'speaking good Chinese is cool' — signals a quiet identity shift in Southeast Asia's ethnic Chinese communities. Mandarin is being redefined from inherited obligation to cultural capital: a pass into China, a tool for content creation, and a transnational mobility skill. Economic gravity, study-and-travel booms, and social media drive the change, yet the 'cool' rebranding also exposes youth to geopolitical scrutiny.

title: 原子进场，比特出局：峇淡岛的工厂与马尼拉的工位
subtitle: 关税战把实体制造推进东南亚，生成式AI却在抽走这里的白领岗位——同一场外部冲击，两个相反方向
country: 印度尼西亚 / 菲律宾
summary: 同一周，印尼峇淡岛因美国关税战崛起为代工转移基地（增速6.8%），菲律宾外包业员工却在训练AI后被裁。本文认为两者是一枚硬币：关税把实体生产推进东南亚，AI把认知工作抽离东南亚，委托方却是同一批欧美企业。三重不对称关键——搬迁可逆而AI替代不可逆；数据中心资本密集而外包业以190万岗位养活中产。

en.title: Atoms In, Bits Out: Batam's Factories, Manila's Desks, and Southeast Asia's Two-Front Reordering
en.subtitle: The tariff war is pushing physical production into the region while generative AI pulls cognitive work out of it — one external shock, two opposite directions
en.summary: In a single news cycle, Indonesia's Batam emerged as a tariff-driven relocation hub for contract manufacturing while Philippine outsourcing workers were dismissed after training the AI that replaced them. This piece argues the two are one ledger: the same Western cost decisions push atoms into the region and pull bits out of it. Three asymmetries matter — relocation is reversible while automation is not; data centres are capital-intensive while BPO sustained 1.9 million jobs; and the specific engine that built a Filipino middle class has no equivalent in what is arriving.

summary: 2026年8月5日，纪录片《给阿嬷的情书》在雅加达首映。82岁的陈美专在片中“木生”下南洋的故事里，认出了父亲从广东揭阳漂洋过海、在加里曼丹成家的往事。本文借此分析印尼华人记忆如何被近三十年的华文禁令结构性压抑，又如何借电影、家书与侨乡纽带重新接上——“根”往往要靠一代代人主动去重新听见。

en.title: When the Screen Spoke Teochew: A Film and the Slow Thaw of Indonesia's Chinese Memory
en.subtitle: From the Jakarta premiere of 'A Letter to Amah' to a diaspora memory suppressed by structural silence and reconnected through culture
en.summary: On 5 August 2026, the documentary 'A Letter to Amah' premiered in Jakarta. An eighty-two-year-old woman recognized her own father's southward migration in the film's protagonist. This piece reads the moment as a window into how Indonesia's ethnic Chinese memory was structurally silenced for three decades by the ban on Chinese languages and schools, and how it is now being reconnected through film, family letters, and qiaoxiang ties.

subtitle: 从 5.9 到 6.2 的分值轨迹背后，是经济引力、机制升级与南海暗流的合力
summary: 基于清华大学国际关系研究院《中国与大国关系分值表（1950—2025年8月）》，普拉博沃上台以来双边关系分值从5.9升至6.2，跨入“友好”等级并创历史新高。文章从分值轨迹、首访与联演和2+2与高层互访四块基石、经济互补机遇、纳土纳与措辞风波等暗流四个维度，剖析这一高位运行的现象、机遇与挑战。

en.title: Crossing the "Friendly" Threshold: China-Indonesia Relations Under Prabowo at a Historic High
en.subtitle: Behind the trajectory from 5.9 to 6.2 — economic gravity, institutional upgrading, and South China Sea undercurrents
en.summary: Based on Tsinghua University's Institute of International Relations score table, China's Relations with Major Powers (1950–August 2025), bilateral relations rose from 5.9 to 6.2 under Prabowo, crossing into the "friendly" band at a historic high. The piece examines this high plateau across four dimensions: the score trajectory, four cornerstones (first visit, joint drill, 2+2, high-level exchanges), economic complementarity, and undercurrents from Natuna to wording storms.
